title: A Parasite With A Title
text: to true leadership measures its success by the diminishing dependency of its followers this is a very subtle statement read it carefully write it down true leadership is measured as being successful when the dependency of its followers diminishes in other words the less they need you the more effective you are so if you need people to need you and to always be with you and to depend on you you are not a leader you are a parasite with a title you're feeding on people
